updates.title: v2.1.235
updates.summary: Ce qui a change Ajout de an optional spellcheck parametre that underlines misspelled words in the prompt entree as you taper, using your installed aspell, hunspell, or ispell Correction de whole-prompt-cache invalidation when a language server disconnected or reconnected mid-session Correction de nested markdown list items misaligning
updates.summary_en:
What's changed

Added an optional spellcheck setting that underlines misspelled words in the prompt input as you type, using your installed aspell, hunspell, or ispell
Fixed whole-prompt-cache invalidation when a language server disconnected or reconnected mid-session
Fixed nested markdown list items misaligning

updates.title: v2.1.234
updates.summary: Ce qui a change Ajout de the optional CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME variable d'environnement: hosts that give each session its own config repertoire can choose a short nom for the per-project transcript repertoire Ajout de the selection:clear keybinding action, so a key can be bound to clear an in-app text selection; also works in the agents view Ad
updates.summary_en:
What's changed

Added the optional CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME environment variable: hosts that give each session its own config directory can choose a short name for the per-project transcript directory
Added the selection:clear keybinding action, so a key can be bound to clear an in-app text selection; also works in the agents view

updates.title: v2.1.233
updates.summary: Ce qui a change Ajout de GitLab merge request URL prise en charge to the --worktree flag and the claude agents view (where MRs display as !N) Ajout de an opt-in forward_utilisateur_identity apps gateway parametre on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in utilisateur's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per us
updates.summary_en:
What's changed

Added GitLab merge request URL support to the --worktree flag and the claude agents view (where MRs display as !N)
Added an opt-in forward_user_identity apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per us

Added GitLab merge request URL support to the --worktree flag and the claude agents view (where MRs display as !N)

updates.title: v2.1.232
updates.summary: Ce qui a change Subagent duplication is now on by par defaut: a subagent_taper: "dupliquer" subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the arriere-plan by par defaut Taper @ in the prompt to mention another Claude session by nom; Claude then uses SendMessage to reach that
updates.summary_en:
What's changed

Subagent forking is now on by default: a subagent_type: "fork" subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background by default
Type @ in the prompt to mention another Claude session by name; Claude then uses SendMessage to reach that

changelog_items.text: Subagent forking is now on by default: a subagent_type: "fork" subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background
